glosses: to dip up; to eat (a liquid, e.g. sauce, oil) by dipping something (usually bread) into it

examples.text: Nachdem er die Nudeln aufgegessen hatte, tunkte er die Soße mit einem Brötchen auf.
examples.translation: After finishing the noodles, he sopped up the sauce with a roll.
examples.english: After finishing the noodles, he sopped up the sauce with a roll.
